name: incomingCall
title: Incoming Call
description: Urgent, interruptive, comeback, or dramatic moment where the brand/product conceptually calls the viewer. Avoid as the default for generic URL launches or calm explanations.

vanillasky.useWhen: Urgent, interruptive, comeback, or dramatic moment where the brand/product conceptually calls the viewer. Avoid as the default for generic URL launches or calm explanations.

callerName.label: Caller name
callerName.description: Brand or product name shown as the caller (e.g. 'Linear', 'Stripe', 'Sales', 'Your trial'). 1-3 words reads best — long names wrap to two lines.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Smaller text below the caller name. Default 'is calling....' completes the iOS framing. Override for variations like 'is asking...', 'wants you back...', 'needs you...'.

declineLabel.label: Decline label
declineLabel.description: Label below the red button. Usually leave as 'Decline'.

acceptLabel.label: Accept label
acceptLabel.description: Label below the green button. Usually leave as 'Accept'.

textColor.label: Text color
textColor.description: Override text color (leave empty for white — usually best on media).

mediaUrl.label: Background media
mediaUrl.description: Optional photo or video URL behind this scene. When set, replaces the brand gradient.

mediaKeyword.label: Background search keyword
mediaKeyword.description: 2-4 word English term for Pexels stock-footage search (auto-fills mediaUrl).

mediaType.label: Background media type
mediaType.description: auto detects photo/video from URL. 'gradient' is a deliberate mode — atmospheric brand-color scene with no stock footage.

mediaPoster.label: Background poster image
mediaPoster.description: Still image URL shown while a video backdrop is decoding its first frame. Auto-filled from Pexels' thumbnail when fillPexelsUrls sets a video mediaUrl. Hides the gradient flash that would otherwise appear in the ~50–400ms gap between a <video> mounting and decoding its first frame.
